name: MCP flow — pipeline test
initialPrompt: Animate this 6-frame MCP connector setup flow. The user clicks the URL field, the dropdown opens, they pick Notion, the form auto-populates, they click submit, and the connection succeeds. Use a mouse cursor that moves between targets with click ripples. Drive each transition off the [SEQUENCE DIFF] so only the deltas animate — don't crossfade whole frames. Make it snappy, ~10 seconds.
